description:
Done. Baseline 463 failed / 1273 passed; now 274 failed / 1462 passed. 189 failures cleared by two harness fixes, and the rest are clustered with a child issue each.

Root causes, measured rather than guessed:
- 209 failures: 9 test files imported App\Modules\TaskRunner\TestTask, a namespace that does not exist. The fixture is App\Modules\TaskRunner\Tests\Helpers\TestTask. One wrong import, copied around.
- 66 failures: 24 module test files bound no TestCase at all, so no Laravel app booted and the container threw "Target class [config]/[log] does not exist" on first use.
- 1 fatal: HandlesCallbacksTest redeclared two trait-owned properties on an anonymous class, which PHP rejects at composition. It had been masked because the file died at the app() call above before PHP ever composed the class - binding a TestCase unmasked it, and it aborted the whole run until fixed.

Remaining 274, each with an issue: ISS-010 command-signature drift (61), ISS-011 schema drift (~25), ISS-012 Pest skip() in PHPUnit classes (10), ISS-013 an empty 1-byte test file. The balance are ordinary assertion failures spread thin across TaskControllerTest, TaskViewRendererTest, ConnectionManagerTest and the Livewire tests.
title: Cluster the TaskRunner module-test failures into an ordered report
